items.q: We ______ football in the park when it suddenly started to pour.
items.vi: Chúng tôi đang chơi bóng đá trong công viên thì trời bỗng đổ mưa như trút.
items.explanation:
Past continuous for a longer action in progress that a shorter past action interrupts — the clue is when it suddenly started: were playing.
✗ played — past simple would make the two events a sequence, not one cutting into the other; ✗ have played — present perfect cannot sit with a finished past time (when it started); ✗ had played — past perfect would mean the game was already over before the rain.

items.q: We moved to a quiet ______ near the river, where all the neighbours know each other.
items.vi: Chúng tôi chuyển đến một khu dân cư yên tĩnh gần bờ sông, nơi hàng xóm đều quen biết nhau.
items.explanation:
Word choice for a small residential area: neighbourhood — the clue is all the neighbours know each other, so it is the streets where people live close together.
✗ region — a large part of a country (the Mekong region); ✗ territory — land owned or controlled by a country or an animal; ✗ zone — an area marked off for a purpose (a no-parking zone), not somewhere you move to live.

items.q: Please ______ attention to the safety rules before you start the chemistry experiment.
items.vi: Hãy chú ý đến các quy tắc an toàn trước khi bạn bắt đầu thí nghiệm hóa học.
items.explanation:
Collocation: the fixed verb with attention is pay attention to, here to the safety rules.
✗ give — you give advice, help or a hand; 'give attention' is not the set phrase; ✗ take — you take notes, care or a break, never attention; ✗ put — you put effort into something; 'put attention' is a direct translation English does not use.

items.q: Now that Mr Ba is retiring, he wants to ______ and let the younger teachers run the football club.
items.vi: Giờ sắp nghỉ hưu, thầy Ba muốn lui về phía sau và để các giáo viên trẻ điều hành câu lạc bộ bóng đá.
items.explanation:
Idiom: take a back seat = stop leading and let others take charge — the clue is retiring and let the younger teachers run the club.
✗ take a rain check — decline an invitation now, accept it later; ✗ take the floor — begin speaking to a group; ✗ take a stand — declare and defend a firm opinion.

items.q: My grandparents still live in the small town ______ my father grew up.
items.vi: Ông bà tôi vẫn sống ở thị trấn nhỏ nơi bố tôi lớn lên.
items.explanation:
Relative adverb of place: where stands for 'in the town' and is followed by a complete clause — my father grew up already has its subject and verb and needs no object.
✗ which — a pronoun that must be subject or object of the clause; it would need 'in which'; ✗ whose — shows possession and must be followed by a noun (whose streets); ✗ who — refers to a person, not a town.

items.q: Lan: How did you ______ that the test was cancelled? / Nam: Our teacher posted it in the class group.
items.vi: Lan: Sao cậu biết được là bài kiểm tra bị hủy? / Nam: Cô giáo đăng trong nhóm lớp.
items.explanation:
Phrasal verb: find out = discover a fact — the clue is that Nam answers how he learned the news (the class group).
✗ look out — be careful, watch out; ✗ make out — see or hear something with difficulty; ✗ turn out — prove to be in the end; it is used with 'it' (it turned out that…), not with 'you' + 'that'.

items.q: The streets are all wet this morning. It ______ have rained during the night.
items.vi: Sáng nay đường phố ướt hết cả. Chắc hẳn đêm qua trời đã mưa.
items.explanation:
Modal deduction: must have + past participle = a confident conclusion about the past drawn from evidence — the clue is the streets are all wet.
✗ can't have — the opposite deduction, 'I'm sure it didn't'; ✗ should have — says what was right but was not done (you should have studied), not a guess; ✗ needn't have — says something was done but was unnecessary, not a guess about what happened.

items.q: The little shelter at the bus ______ outside our school keeps us dry when it rains.
items.vi: Mái che nhỏ ở trạm xe buýt trước cổng trường giúp chúng tôi khỏi bị ướt khi trời mưa.
items.explanation:
Word choice: a bus stop is the small roadside point where a bus picks passengers up — the clue is a little shelter outside our school.
✗ station — a large building where trains or many bus routes start and end; ✗ terminal — the main building at the end of a route or at an airport; ✗ harbour — a sheltered port for ships, not buses.

items.q: By the time the bus finally came, we ______ for over half an hour.
items.vi: Đến lúc xe buýt cuối cùng cũng tới, chúng tôi đã đợi hơn nửa tiếng.
items.explanation:
Past perfect for an action completed before a past moment — the clue is By the time + past simple (came) with the duration for over half an hour: had waited.
✗ waited — past simple puts the waiting at the same time as the bus's arrival, not before it; ✗ have waited — present perfect cannot combine with a past-time clause ('came'); ✗ are waiting — present continuous clashes with a past narrative.

items.q: There is ______ traffic on this road in the early morning, so we usually get to school on time.
items.vi: Sáng sớm đường này rất ít xe cộ, nên chúng tôi thường đến trường đúng giờ.
items.explanation:
Quantifier with an uncountable noun: traffic has no plural, so it takes little (= not much) — and little traffic is why they get to school on time.
✗ few — only with plural countable nouns (few cars); ✗ a few — also countable-only, and 'some' traffic would not explain arriving on time; ✗ many — countable-only, and heavy traffic would make them late.

items.q: Nam usually ______ his homework right after dinner so he can watch TV later.
items.vi: Nam thường làm bài tập về nhà ngay sau bữa tối để lát nữa được xem tivi.
items.explanation:
Collocation: do homework is the fixed pair — do goes with tasks and duties (do the dishes, do an exercise).
✗ makes — make is for producing something (make a cake, make a decision), never homework; ✗ writes — you write an essay or a letter; 'write homework' is not the English collocation; ✗ works — has no object here; it would need a preposition (work on his homework).

items.q: If it ______ so cold today, we would go for a walk along the river.
items.vi: Nếu hôm nay trời không lạnh thế này thì chúng tôi sẽ đi dạo dọc bờ sông.
items.explanation:
Second conditional for an unreal present — the clues are today and would go in the main clause (it really is cold): if + past subjunctive weren't.
✗ isn't — present simple makes a first conditional, which pairs with 'will', not 'would'; ✗ hadn't been — past perfect belongs to the third conditional about the past (would have gone); ✗ wouldn't be — 'would' never goes inside the if-clause.

items.q: There is a small ______ in the middle of town where people sit and feed the pigeons.
items.vi: Có một quảng trường nhỏ ở giữa thị trấn, nơi mọi người ngồi cho bồ câu ăn.
items.explanation:
Word choice: a square is an open public space in a town — the clue is in the middle of town where people sit and feed pigeons.
✗ corner — the point where two streets meet, not a space to sit in; ✗ yard — an enclosed area beside a house or school, not public; ✗ block — a group of buildings between streets, which you walk around, not sit in.

items.q: Our old school bus ______ on the way to the museum, so we arrived an hour late.
items.vi: Chiếc xe buýt cũ của trường bị hỏng giữa đường đến bảo tàng, nên chúng tôi tới muộn một tiếng.
items.explanation:
Phrasal verb: a vehicle or machine breaks down when it stops working — the clue is the bus stopped and we arrived an hour late.
✗ broke up — end a relationship, or (of school) close for the holidays; ✗ broke out — start suddenly (a fire, a war, a fight); ✗ made up — invent a story, or make peace after a quarrel.

items.q: Lan has practised the piano every day for months; ______, she played beautifully at the school concert.
items.vi: Lan đã luyện đàn piano mỗi ngày suốt nhiều tháng; vì vậy, cô ấy chơi rất hay trong buổi hòa nhạc của trường.
items.explanation:
Linking word of result: therefore = as a result — the clue is cause (months of practice) followed by effect (played beautifully).
✗ however — introduces a contrast, but practising and playing well do not contradict; ✗ otherwise — means 'if not', which would need a warning about what happens without practice; ✗ meanwhile — 'at the same time', but the concert came after the months of practice.

items.q: Lan: Have you finished your maths homework? / Nam: Not yet. I ______ the last two problems.
items.vi: Lan: Cậu làm xong bài tập toán chưa? / Nam: Chưa. Tớ vẫn chưa làm hai bài cuối.
items.explanation:
Present perfect for an action not completed up to now — the clues are Not yet and the question Have you finished: haven't done.
✗ don't do — present simple describes a habit, not the state of one piece of homework; ✗ didn't do — past simple needs a finished past time (yesterday) and would mean he is not going to do them; ✗ hadn't done — past perfect needs an earlier past reference point, but the time here is now.

items.q: Before opening a second shop, Mrs Hoa decided to ______ by selling her cakes at the weekend market.
items.vi: Trước khi mở cửa hàng thứ hai, cô Hoa quyết định thăm dò thị trường bằng cách bán bánh ở chợ cuối tuần.
items.explanation:
Idiom: test the waters = try something in a small way before committing — the clue is Before opening a second shop she sells at a market first.
✗ break the ice — make people relax when they first meet; ✗ hit the road — leave, set off on a journey; ✗ clear the air — settle a misunderstanding or bad feeling between people.

items.q: Turn left at the ______ where Nguyen Trai Street meets Le Loi Street, and the school is on your right.
items.vi: Rẽ trái ở ngã tư nơi đường Nguyễn Trãi giao với đường Lê Lợi, trường ở bên tay phải.
items.explanation:
Word choice: a junction is the place where two roads meet — the clue is where Nguyen Trai Street meets Le Loi Street.
✗ lane — a narrow road, or one strip of a wide road; ✗ pavement — the path beside the road for walking on; ✗ bridge — a structure carrying a road over a river or another road.

items.q: Lan: ______ I borrow your ruler for a minute? / Nam: Sure, here you are.
items.vi: Lan: Tớ mượn thước của cậu một lát được không? / Nam: Được chứ, đây này.
items.explanation:
Modal for permission: Could I…? is a polite request — the clue is Nam's reply Sure, here you are, which grants it.
✗ Must — 'Must I borrow?' asks whether I am obliged to, which makes no sense here; ✗ Should — asks for advice about the right thing to do; ✗ Would — 'Would I borrow?' asks about my own future action; a request with would is 'Would you lend me…?'.

items.q: Remember ______ your raincoat tomorrow; it looks like a storm is coming.
items.vi: Nhớ mang áo mưa ngày mai nhé; có vẻ bão sắp đến rồi.
items.explanation:
Gerund vs infinitive: remember + to-infinitive = not forget a task still to come — the clue is tomorrow: to take.
✗ taking — 'remember doing' is a memory of something already done, impossible for tomorrow; ✗ take — a bare infinitive never follows 'remember'; ✗ to taking — 'to' + -ing only follows a few phrases (look forward to, be used to), not remember.

items.q: The new bridge, ______ opened last month, has cut my journey to school in half.
items.vi: Cây cầu mới, mới thông xe tháng trước, đã rút ngắn quãng đường đến trường của tôi một nửa.
items.explanation:
Non-defining relative clause (between commas) about a thing: which is the subject of opened.
✗ that — cannot be used after a comma in a non-defining clause; ✗ where — a relative adverb, so it needs a full clause with its own subject after it (where I cross the river); ✗ what — not a relative pronoun; it means 'the thing that' and cannot follow a noun.

items.q: Hurry up, or we'll ______ the school bus again and have to walk!
items.vi: Nhanh lên, không thì chúng ta lại lỡ xe buýt của trường và phải đi bộ đấy!
items.explanation:
Collocation: you miss a bus, train or plane when you arrive too late to catch it — the clue is Hurry up and have to walk.
✗ lose — you lose an object or a game; 'lose the bus' is a translation from Vietnamese, not English; ✗ drop — let something fall, or stop doing it; ✗ fail — not succeed at an exam or a task; it does not take a bus as its object.

items.q: ______ had we left the house when it began to snow.
items.vi: Chúng tôi vừa mới ra khỏi nhà thì tuyết bắt đầu rơi.
items.explanation:
Inversion: Hardly + had + subject + past participle… when — the clue is when after the inverted clause.
✗ No sooner — the same inversion but must pair with than, not 'when'; ✗ Not until — must be followed by a time phrase or clause before the inverted main verb (Not until midnight did we leave); ✗ Only — needs a phrase after it first (Only then / Only when) to trigger inversion; on its own it cannot start 'had we left'.

items.q: Sa Pa is a favourite ______ for tourists who want to see snow in winter.
items.vi: Sa Pa là điểm đến yêu thích của du khách muốn ngắm tuyết vào mùa đông.
items.explanation:
Word choice: a destination is the place you travel to — the clue is for tourists who want to see snow, Sa Pa is where they go.
✗ direction — the way you head (north, left), not a place; ✗ journey — the act of travelling, not the place you reach; ✗ arrival — the act of reaching a place (an arrivals hall), not a location.

items.q: This time next week, we ______ on the beach in Nha Trang instead of sitting in class.
items.vi: Giờ này tuần sau, chúng tôi sẽ đang nằm trên bãi biển Nha Trang thay vì ngồi trong lớp.
items.explanation:
Future continuous for an action in progress at a fixed future moment — the clue is This time next week: will be lying.
✗ lie — present simple is for habits or timetables, not a picture of one future moment; ✗ are lying — present continuous means happening now or a fixed arrangement, not being in the middle of an action at a future time; ✗ have lain — present perfect looks back at a finished action, not forward.
